* [release/8.0] Update dependencies from dotnet/source-build-externals by @dotnet-maestro in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/54744

* [release/8.0] Update dependencies from dotnet/source-build-externals by @dotnet-maestro in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/54744
